summary: Happy City Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K containing unaudited financial results for the six months ended February 28, 2026. The report includes MD&A and interim financial statements. Revenue fell 44.2% to $2.32M, with a net loss of $2.62M versus a prior-year profit, attributed to competitive dining options in Shenzhen. This is a routine earnings disclosure with no special-situation elements such as acquisitions, strategic reviews, or capital actions. The filing is a standard current report for a foreign private issuer, not an event-driven corporate action.
